title: Compact-support projection maps commute with etale exchange
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $f:X\to S$ be a compactifiable morphism between Noetherian schemes [def-asd-compactifiable]. Let $v:S'\to S$ be a morphism with Noetherian $S'$, and form $X'=X\times_S S'$ with maps $v_X:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$, using a compactification of $f$ and its base change. Work in the ordinary unbounded etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact inverse images and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For arbitrary $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $Q\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, write $b_M:v^*Rf_!M\to Rf'_!v_X^*M$, with $Rf_!$ and $Rf'_!$ the compact direct images of these compactifications [def-amb-etale-compact-support], for the compactification-defined exchange (the proper ordinary unit--square--counit exchange [sbc-def-base-change-map] followed by extension-by-zero base change [sbc-prop-extension-by-zero-and-arbitrary-base-change]). Write $\Pi_{f,Q,M}:Q\otimes_A^L Rf_!M\to Rf_!(f^*Q\otimes_A^L M)$ for the canonical compact-support projection map, constructed by the proper counit-defined projection map [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection] and the extension-by-zero tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor]. Then
$$b_{f^*Q\otimes_A^L M}\circ v^*(\Pi_{f,Q,M})=\Pi_{f',v^*Q,v_X^*M}\circ(1_{v^*Q}\otimes b_M),$$
after identifying the source $v^*(Q\otimes_A^L Rf_!M)$ with $v^*Q\otimes_A^L v^*Rf_!M$ and the target using $v_X^*f^*Q\cong f'^*v^*Q$. No boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Proof, last paragraph: compatibility implicit in transporting the internal adjunction through compact-support exchange

proof.text: Fix the compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}S$ used in the statement and its specified base change $(j',p')$, and write $a:\overline X'\to\overline X$ and $u=v_X$. All tensors below are ordinary derived tensors over $A$. First put the coefficient on the right: let $P_f(M,Q):Rf_!M\otimes Q\to Rf_!(M\otimes f^*Q)$ be the composite $Rp_*(\gamma_{j;M,p^*Q})\circ\pi_{p;j_!M,Q}$, where $\pi$ is the adjunct-of-counit projection and $\gamma$ is the open tensor comparison. Write $e_E:v^*Rp_*E\to Rp'_*a^*E$ for proper exchange, and $\beta_M:a^*j_!M\to j'_!u^*M$ for open base change. Unfolding the compactification-defined exchange gives $b_M=Rp'_*(\beta_M)\circ e_{j_!M}$. These are definitions of the two composites, without asserting invertibility of $e$ or $\pi$.

source.place: equation-projection-formula-map and lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; compactification composite as specified in the item

proof.text:
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence] to the square $(p,p',v,a)$ of the constant-$A$ small etale ringed topoi, with $E=j_!M$ and coefficient $Q$. The structural-ring maps are the canonical identifications of inverse images of the constant ring. Its proper exchange is exactly $e$: the transpose in [sbc-def-base-change-map] is the pulled-back counit preceded by the pullback-square isomorphism, which is also the mate defining $e$ in the cited coherence lemma. If $\theta:p'^*v^*Q\xrightarrow{\sim}a^*p^*Q$ and $d_E=(1\otimes\theta^{-1})t_a:a^*(E\otimes p^*Q)\xrightarrow{\sim}a^*E\otimes p'^*v^*Q$, the cited identity reads
$$Rp'_*(d_E)\,e_{E\otimes p^*Q}\,v^*(\pi_{p;E,Q})=\pi_{p';a^*E,v^*Q}(e_E\otimes1)t_v.$$
The lemma applies to arbitrary unbounded $E,Q$ and to arbitrary commutative ringed squares, so no base-change isomorphism theorem or coefficient restriction is being assumed here.

Apply [lem-asd-open-projection-exchange] to $(j,j',a,u)$, $E=M$ and $N=p^*Q$. Set $O=M\otimes f^*Q$. Insert $j^*p^*=f^*$ and $j'^*p'^*=f'^*$ in its formula. The pullback-composition/tensor coherence of [lem-kun-derived-pullback-composition-monoidal] identifies its $c_{p^*Q}$, followed by $j'^*(\theta^{-1})$, with the composite $u^*f^*Q\cong f'^*v^*Q$. After identifying tensor pullbacks, its conclusion is precisely
$$\widetilde\beta_O\,a^*(\gamma_{j;M,p^*Q})=\gamma_{j';u^*M,p'^*v^*Q}(\beta_M\otimes1)d_E,$$
where $\widetilde\beta_O$ denotes $\beta_O$ followed by $j'_!$ of the tensor and square comparisons $u^*O\cong u^*M\otimes f'^*v^*Q$. This equation supplies the open factor; it is not inferred just from existence of the two open isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor, and Tag 03S6, lemma-shriek-base-change: their open-factor compatibility, extracted as lem-asd-open-projection-exchange

proof.text:
Naturality of proper exchange at the actual morphism $\gamma=\gamma_{j;M,p^*Q}:E\otimes p^*Q\to j_!O$ gives
$$e_{j_!O}\,v^*Rp_*(\gamma)=Rp'_*a^*(\gamma)\,e_{E\otimes p^*Q}.$$
Expand $b_Ov^*P_f$ using step 1, use this naturality equation, and then substitute the open-factor identity of step 3. The resulting composite is
$$Rp'_*(\gamma')\,Rp'_*(\beta_M\otimes1)\,Rp'_*(d_E)\,e_{E\otimes p^*Q}\,v^*(\pi_p),$$
where $\gamma'=\gamma_{j';u^*M,p'^*v^*Q}$ and the target comparison is the one defining $\widetilde\beta_O$. This is only functoriality of $Rp'_*$, associativity of composition and naturality of the already cited transformations.

source.place: remark-compatible-with-diagram: naturality and pasting of the two factor squares

proof.text:
Replace $Rp'_*(d_E)e_{E\otimes p^*Q}v^*\pi_p$ in step 4 by the right side of step 2. Naturality in its first argument of the counit-defined projection of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], applied to $\beta_M:a^*E\to j'_!u^*M$, gives
$$Rp'_*(\beta_M\otimes1)\,\pi_{p';a^*E,v^*Q}=\pi_{p';j'_!u^*M,v^*Q}(Rp'_*(\beta_M)\otimes1).$$
Thus the preceding composite becomes $P_{f'}(u^*M,v^*Q)(b_M\otimes1)t_v$. We have proved the right-coefficient version of the desired equality, with exactly the specified exchange, since $Rp'_*(\beta_M)e_E=b_M$. Only naturality and substitution in the displayed equations are used in this step.

source.place: equation-projection-formula-map and remark-compatible-with-diagram: final naturality square

proof.text:
Return to the coefficient-first convention of the item. By [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection] its proper map is $Rp_*(\sigma)\pi_p\sigma$, where $\sigma$ is tensor symmetry. The open map in this convention is likewise $j_!(\sigma)\gamma_j\sigma$. Hence the adjacent two symmetries on $j_!M\otimes p^*Q$ cancel, and the compactification composite is
$$\Pi_{f,Q,M}=Rf_!(\sigma_{M,f^*Q})\,P_f(M,Q)\,\sigma_{Q,Rf_!M}.$$
Use naturality of the symmetry [lem-kun-tensor-sym] and of the comparisons already used above to conjugate the equality of step 5 by these symmetries. The canonical pullback/tensor comparison commutes with this swap: on the signed total tensor representatives it leaves bidegree $(r,s)$ and the scalar $(-1)^{rs}$ unchanged. The outside swaps therefore turn $b_M\otimes1$ into $1\otimes b_M$ and turn $P_f,P_{f'}$ into $\Pi_f,\Pi_{f'}$. This gives exactly the displayed equation of the item, with its stated source and target identifications. The argument uses no boundedness or constructibility and does not invert the proper exchange or proper projection.
